name: A Paladin's Steed
summary: A paladin’s warhorse bears its rider and arms into battle. Danitha Morr can teach you to summon one of your own.

sections.title: A Warhorse for Battle
sections.body: Paladins have long ridden specially consecrated warhorses into battle, carrying their riders and arms. Danitha Morr can teach you to summon a steed of your own, so you can ride into battle with one at your side.

faq.answer: It is a specially consecrated warhorse that carries a paladin and their arms into battle.

faq.q: Who teaches me to summon a warhorse?
faq.answer: Danitha Morr teaches you to summon your warhorse.

faq.q: Why do paladins need a warhorse?
faq.answer: A warhorse bears a paladin and their arms into battle.

angles.text: As a paladin, you can call upon a specially consecrated warhorse to carry you and your arms into battle.

attribution: In-game quest text: A Paladin's Steed
